mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN A."アカウント種別" = 'STUDENT' THEN A."アカウントID" ELSE S."アカウントID" END FROM public."ACC_アカウント" A LEFT JOIN public."ACC_アカウント" S ON A."アカウント種別" = 'GUARDIAN' AND S."保護者ID" = A."アカウントID" AND S."アカウント種別" = 'STUDENT' AND S."状態" = '1' WHERE A."アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND A."アカウント種別" = #{accountType} AND A."状態" = '1' AND (A."アカウント種別" = 'STUDENT' OR S."アカウントID" IS NOT NULL)
SELECT * FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} ORDER BY "表示順", "フォルダ名称", "フォルダID"
SELECT * FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID" = #{folderId}

WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS ( SELECT "フォルダID", ARRAY["フォルダ名称"]::text[] AS path FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} AND "親フォルダID" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child."フォルダID", parent.path || child."フォルダ名称" FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" child JOIN folder_tree parent ON child."親フォルダID" = parent."フォルダID" WHERE child."家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} ) SELECT unnest(path) AS folder_name FROM folder_tree WHERE "フォルダID" = #{folderId}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT "フォルダID", "親フォルダID", 1 AS depth FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID" = #{folderId} UNION ALL SELECT parent."フォルダID", parent."親フォルダID", child.depth + 1 FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" parent JOIN ancestors child ON parent."フォルダID" = child."親フォルダID" WHERE parent."家族学生ID" = #{familyStudentId} ) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(depth), 0) FROM ancestors
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."DOC_フォルダ情報" ("家族学生ID", "親フォルダID", "フォルダ名称", "表示順", "備考", "登録ID", "更新ID") VALUES (#{familyStudentId}, #{parentFolderId}, #{folderName}, #{displayOrder}, #{note}, CAST(#{familyStudentId} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{familyStudentId} AS VARCHAR))
mapper.update: UPDATE public."DOC_フォルダ情報" SET "親フォルダID"=#{parentFolderId}, "フォルダ名称"=#{folderName}, "表示順"=#{displayOrder}, "備考"=#{note}, "更新ID"=#{operator}, "更新日時"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID"=#{folderId}

WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS ( SELECT "フォルダID", ARRAY["フォルダ名称"]::text[] AS path FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "親フォルダID" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child."フォルダID", parent.path || child."フォルダ名称" FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" child JOIN folder_tree parent ON child."親フォルダID"=parent."フォルダID" WHERE child."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} ), subtree AS ( SELECT "フォルダID" FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID"=#{folderId} UNION ALL SELECT child."フォルダID" FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" child JOIN subtree parent ON child."親フォルダID"=parent."フォルダID" WHERE child."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} ) UPDATE public."DOC_資料情報" d SET "大分類"=tree.path[1], "中分類"=tree.path[2], "小分類"=tree.path[3], "細分類"=tree.path[4] FROM folder_tree tree WHERE tree."フォルダID"=d."フォルダID" AND d."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND d."フォルダID" IN (SELECT "フォルダID" FROM subtree) AND (d."大分類" IS DISTINCT FROM tree.path[1] OR d."中分類" IS DISTINCT FROM tree.path[2] OR d."小分類" IS DISTINCT FROM tree.path[3] OR d."細分類" IS DISTINCT FROM tree.path[4])
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "親フォルダID"=#{folderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public."DOC_資料情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID"=#{folderId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."DOC_フォルダ情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "フォルダID"=#{folderId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public."DOC_資料情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "資料番号"=#{documentNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public."DOC_資料情報" WHERE "資料番号"=#{documentNo}
SELECT 1 FROM public."DOC_資料情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "資料番号"=#{documentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."DOC_資料情報" ("資料番号","家族学生ID","フォルダID","ステータス","有効期限","大分類","中分類","小分類","細分類", "コメント","登録ID","更新ID","登録日時","更新日時") VALUES (#{documentNo},#{familyStudentId},#{folderId},#{status},#{expiryDate},#{largeCategory},#{mediumCategory}, #{smallCategory},#{detailCategory},#{comment},CAST(#{familyStudentId} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{familyStudentId} AS VARCHAR),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE public."DOC_資料情報" SET "フォルダID"=#{document.folderId}, "ステータス"=#{document.status}, "有効期限"=#{document.expiryDate}, "大分類"=#{document.largeCategory}, "中分類"=#{document.mediumCategory}, "小分類"=#{document.smallCategory}, "細分類"=#{document.detailCategory}, "コメント"=#{document.comment}, "更新ID"=#{operator}, "更新日時"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "資料番号"=#{document.documentNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."DOC_資料情報" WHERE "家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND "資料番号"=#{documentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT D.* FROM public."DOC_資料詳細情報" D JOIN public."DOC_資料情報" M ON M."資料番号"=D."資料番号" WHERE M."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND D."資料番号"=#{documentNo} ORDER BY D."枝番号"
SELECT D.* FROM public."DOC_資料詳細情報" D JOIN public."DOC_資料情報" M ON M."資料番号"=D."資料番号" WHERE M."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} ORDER BY D."資料番号", D."枝番号"
SELECT D.* FROM public."DOC_資料詳細情報" D JOIN public."DOC_資料情報" M ON M."資料番号"=D."資料番号" WHERE M."家族学生ID"=#{familyStudentId} AND D."資料番号"=#{documentNo} AND D."枝番号"=#{branchNo}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX("枝番号"),0) FROM public."DOC_資料詳細情報" WHERE "資料番号"=#{documentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."DOC_資料詳細情報" ("資料番号","枝番号","拡張子","元ファイル名称","縮略ファイル500","縮略ファイル200","縮略ファイル50", "コメント","パス","ファイル名称","登録ID","更新ID","登録日時","更新日時") VALUES (#{file.documentNo},#{file.branchNo},#{file.extension},#{file.originalFileName},#{file.thumbnail500}, #{file.thumbnail200},#{file.thumbnail50},#{file.comment},#{file.path},#{file.storedFileName},#{operator}, #{operator},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
